message.content:
Based on the images provided, here is the analysis of the extracted assets:

**(1) Description of 'blue_rect.png'**
This image contains the **top portion of the brochure cover**. Specifically, it shows a **white air conditioning unit** (split system indoor unit) mounted against the dark blue background. You can see the main body of the unit, the sensor/display area at the bottom right, and the top of the air vents. The white border of the main design frame is also visible at the very top and sides.

**(2) Analysis of 'logo_dark_bg.png'**
**No, this is not just the logo.** This image is a crop that includes the **air conditioning unit** and the **dark blue background**, but it is missing the actual logo elements (the wind icon and the "Celsius" text). It appears to be the upper section of the cover where the product image sits, rather than the brand mark itself.

**(3) Quality Assessment of 'logo_white_trim.png'**
*   **Wind Icon:** **No**, the wind icon is **not clearly visible** (or entirely missing). The image seems to be cropped tightly around the air conditioner unit shown in the other files.
*   **Wordmark:** **No**, the "Celsius" wordmark is **not readable** or present in this specific crop.
*   **Artifacts/Details:** The image shows the AC unit in white/grayscale on a transparent background (indicated by the checkerboard). There are some slight gray artifacts or anti-aliasing shadows around the edges of the white unit, likely from the original background removal process.
*   **Quality Rating: 1/10** (as a logo file). It fails to contain the primary branding elements (icon or text). It functions only as an asset of the product hardware, not the company logo.
